headline: Juventus 60.7% favourites at home to Rennes
summary: Juventus are clear 60.7% favourites for Thursday's Europa League home game against Rennes in Turin. The market rates them about a goal better, on a handicap line of -1. The draw is 22.0%, above a Rennes win at 17.3%. Juventus are missing key attackers, including Yildiz, while Rennes list Lepaul as doubtful with an ankle problem. The goals line is 2.75, and over is 51.2% — the market sees roughly three goals. Both teams to score is 53.3%, so Rennes are more likely than not to find the net. Rennes +1 at 51.7% makes a narrow Juventus win close to even.
